name: Fatoumata Baranov-Fosu
role: Personnel recovery and hostile extraction — extraction specialist
location: The Overhang — residential shelves built onto megastructure exteriors, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Fatoumata Baranov-Fosu is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 30, her face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and she has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. She works as a extraction specialist out of The Overhang, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

she is not the most talented extraction specialist in GLMZ, but she might be the most stubborn, and in this city that's worth more.

core_fears: Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
core_desires: To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
psychology.secret: Fatoumata Baranov-Fosu witnessed a massacre during a corporate dispute and has evidence stored in a dead drop. Publishing it would expose powerful people. Keeping it is leverage and liability.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
example_lines: "We go in, we get the asset, we leave. Everything else is improvisation."
"The extraction window is four minutes. I've done it in three."
"I don't rescue people. I relocate them aggressively."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Fatoumata Baranov-Fosu a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Fatoumata Baranov-Fosu discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Fatoumata Baranov-Fosu owes a personal debt to
narrative_function: Fatoumata Baranov-Fosu is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms. Vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: inability to delegate — must control everything personally
poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Claims to live in the present but is haunted by specific moments from the past that dictate current behavior
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
breaking_points: Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

cyberware_inventory.name: Reflex boosters wired into spinal column
cyberware_inventory.description: Reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms

cyberware_inventory.name: Vocal modulator
cyberware_inventory.description: Vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio

physical_description.heritage: West African / Russian — Mandinka-descended (Fosu) merged with Eastern European (Baranov)
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with defined musculature — dancer's flexibility combined with fighter's efficiency. No wasted mass. Shoulders broad but not bulky, core visibly tight.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, natural with subtle warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a practical high bun or tight cornrows; styled for function, not aesthetics
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm brown with golden undertones — mixed heritage complexity
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, defined jawline. Skin well-maintained but not pampered — minimal scarring on face, suggesting professional discretion. A thin white line runs from left temple toward ear (old blade wound, poorly healed). Her expression defaults to neutral assessment.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left temple toward ear — approximately 4cm, from a blade encounter
Tattoo on right forearm: three interlocking circles in black ink (memorial to her disappeared mentor)
Chrome reflex booster ports visible at base of skull where spinal column augmentation connects — surgical-grade titanium with slight luminescent edge when system is active
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Reflex booster wiring visible at the nape of neck where chrome interfaces with skin — visible when hair is pulled back, which it always is. The ports glow faintly (warm amber) when her nervous system is engaged or during active jobs. No attempt to conceal; it's a warning label.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight balanced, ready to move in any direction. Movement is economical and fluid — no wasted motion, no flourish. Eyes constantly scanning, cataloging exits and threats. She moves like someone who has learned that survival is a series of micro-decisions made at speed.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical: reinforced synthetic-leather jacket (charcoal grey, well-maintained), fitted tactical pants with cargo pockets, heavy-duty boots with grip-soles. Minimal jewelry except a worn silver ring on her right hand (inherited from mentor). Gear is always accessible, always ready. Fabrics are functional — nothing that catches or restricts. She dresses for the job, not the social tier.
